g.text: OpenShelter Frontend - App Architecture (Angular 22, standalone, zoneless)
isVerified(): boolean ' levels has EMAIL or PHONE (backend: any
update(id, request: UpdateShelterRequest) : ShelterDto ' M8: PUT
remove(id) : void ' M8: DELETE (gateway method is remove)
me() : MeResponse ' GET /account/me - real profile + claims + isAdmin
links only; the ONLY network call the /submit short-link mode makes
(long-form URLs never hit the backend - parsed client-side).
DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION - client-side OSM Nominatim via RAW fetch()
(external service: no JWT, no backend hop, never through ApiClient).
The only module that knows the Nominatim URL (jsonv2, limit 5,
countrycodes=ee - Estonia-restricted); hard 1000 ms request spacing
(1 req/s usage policy); attribution always rendered by the caller.
single-sourced row copy + the four-valued provenance badge:
"User-submitted", plus the trust-badge texts) and location-input.ts
Typed models live in core/models.ts - field-for-field mirror of the
backend DTOs (02-CONTEXT-API.md). One caveat fixed against the real
backend: ShelterDto.address is string|null (USER rows store no
address) even though the md types it string.
M3: the shell adds authenticated nav links - "Account" (/account).
M7: the standalone "Verify" link is REMOVED from the nav; /verify stays
reachable by route (guard redirects + the account page's per-contact
admin-moderation D5: the nav gains a SINGLE "Admin" item, rendered only
when AuthStore.isAdmin() is true (from GET /account/me - always present,
false for every regular user) - regular users see the nav unchanged; a
failed profile fetch leaves isAdmin false, so the item hides itself
M4: real Leaflet map + source filter + sidebar
select + zoom to street level (SHELTER_ZOOM 16) and
stay on /map; the selected row's "View details" link
itself shows a static Location map).
leaflet is used directly (npm "leaflet") behind this thin
service - ngx-leaflet style wrappers lag Angular majors and
are NOT used. MapLibre GL is a documented future swap.
/map public -> MapPage (M2 stub page; Leaflet map in M4)
/account AuthGuard -> AccountPage (M3 page; M7 full profile)
